questions.q: Which tool is a ground control station for ArduPilot?
questions.explain: Mission Planner and QGroundControl are GCSs for ArduPilot/PX4: parameters, calibrations, missions, logs.

options: To see changes and roll back
questions.explain: A config is text. Git shows the difference between versions and brings back a working state.

questions.q: Why does a config file name start with the date YYYY-MM-DD?
questions.explain: The year-month-day format sorts lexicographically the same as by time.

questions.q: Why a Python venv per project?
questions.explain: An isolated environment keeps each project's dependencies separate.

questions.q: What should you do before any config change?
options: Reboot the FC and update the firmware
questions.explain: A “before” file is the only way to know exactly what changed when something breaks.

questions.q: Which tool plots expressions like ATT.Roll-ATT.DesRoll?
questions.explain: It comes with the MAVProxy package.

questions.q: What do you need in WSL2 for USB devices?
options: Root access and a DFU driver
questions.explain: Linux is for scripts and logs.

questions.q: What do you use to flash ESCs through the flight controller?
options: ESC Configurator (web) or the Bluejay/AM32 configurator via passthrough
questions.explain: ESCs are flashed through the flight controller's passthrough with a web configurator.
